related_work_items.gap_relevance_note: AdaSVD is part of the immediate method lineage because it motivates adaptive rank allocation, but QSVD shifts that idea to a cross-layer singular-value budget tailored to joint QKV compression in VLMs.

evidence.section: Singular Value Decomposition for Large Models
evidence.evidence_text: Palu [6] and [58] have shifted attention to compressing the KV-Cache, leveraging SVD and low-rank projections to reduce memory footprint.

this work proposes the application of Singular-Value Decomposition (SVD) ... to the joint weight matrices of the query, key, and value. This approach significantly reduces the KV cache size by storing only the latent vectors instead of separate key and value vectors.

related_work_items.gap_relevance_note: Low-rank KV-cache compression papers form the bridge to QSVD's cache-efficiency objective, but the target paper positions its unified QKV factorization as a more integrated way to reduce cache size and compute together.

evidence.evidence_text: A recent proposal, Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA) in the DeepSeek-v3 model [31], offers a novel approach to improving VLM efficiency. It significantly reduces the KV cache size by compressing the KV cache into a latent vector

evidence.section: Singular Value Decomposition for Large Models
evidence.evidence_text: This latent factorization can be viewed as an implicit low-rank approximation applied dynamically during inference, offering complementary benefits to static weight compression methods such as SVD.

related_work_items.gap_relevance_note: The DeepSeek MLA line is a direct bridge because it motivates latent-space KV compression; QSVD adapts that efficiency intuition into a static SVD factorization over concatenated QKV weights.

evidence.evidence_text: MBQ [27] proposes a modality-balanced quantization approach that accounts for the distinct gradient distributions of visual and textual tokens during calibration.

related_work_items.gap_relevance_note: MBQ represents the existing VLM quantization line that QSVD contrasts with to justify combining low-rank QKV compression and quantization in one framework.
